name: GitHub
description: GitHub repo host channel. Connection stub used by github-channel (RepoProvider for triage) and any future GitHub-aware extension.
long_description:
Channel stub that represents the GitHub integration surface. Other extensions declare it as a dependency to signal they need an authenticated GitHub client (today: github-channel; future: code-search, release-notifier, …).

Configuration (App ID, installation id, private key) is held by the github-channel extension because it owns the runtime that uses it. Installing/removing this stub cleanly gates the entire GitHub integration.
author: Kernl
